title: Type II and III systems.
officialText:
Type II and III dry cleaning systems shall be provided with a mechanical ventilation system that is
designed to exhaust 1 cubic foot of air per minute for each square foot of floor area (1 cfm/ft2) (0.00508 m3/(s • m2)) in dry cleaning
rooms and in drying rooms. The ventilation system shall operate automatically when the dry cleaning equipment is in operation and
shall have manual controls at an approved location.
